subject: Web Development
title: Modules: Organizing JavaScript
description: A quick, practical guide to Modules: Organizing JavaScript.

hook.text: Early JavaScript had no module system. Everything lived in one global scope.

buildup.text: Node.js invented CommonJS require() to split code into files. The browser had nothing.

discovery.text: ES Modules arrived in 2015 with import and export — finally, a native browser module system.

twist.text: For years, CommonJS and ES Modules coexisted awkwardly, confusing developers and tools.

climax.text: The ecosystem is slowly converging on ES Modules as the universal standard.

punchline.text: It took twenty years to get official modules.

quiz.question: What module system do modern browsers support natively?
